changes: Explicit spinach-only pasqualina: 600 g frozen spinach replaces the mixed 400 g spinach/200 g chard proposal, as a new culinary input dose, not a fresh/frozen or drained-yield conversion. Standard retains marjoram/nutmeg and extended retains its tomato-basil side; neither duplicates the simpler variant.
Count the oven doneness/temperature check and pan removal as active work before the passive twelve-minute rest.
Retain real spinach/chard draining as unmeasured loss. Use weighed raw shell-free eggs and already grated parmesan. Separate oven preparation; extended frozen basil cooks in a visibly warm salad.
recipes.content_review: Oljedeg omsluter ricotta och gröna blad med hela ägg i gropar, som bakas inne i pajen; skild från öppen tomatpaj och fyllda crespelle.
